description: What the page may ask of its own window: the title bar's drag, minimise, maximise and close, and the maximised state it reflects, plus the events the shell's own commands answer on (core:default). The app's own commands (src/hid.rs, a DualSense and nothing else) are allowed to its one window by Tauri's default for an app that declares no permissions of its own. Nothing else of the host is reachable.
